opening.argument: The video centers on a Veterans' Day restaurant event, not a transaction. Its title identifies a National Anthem performance at Texas Roadhouse, the description says employees were singing, and the audio contains a line from the anthem. The described free meal for veterans is presented as an ordinary benefit associated with that event. Nothing in the supplied account describes an investment offer, payment demand, credential request, or other deceptive way to participate. The evidence supports an event-focused recording without establishing any such mechanism.
